integrity.epistemic_status: Proof checked in the same-model review; no independent mathematical audit or formal verification.
integrity.proof_scope: Self-contained analytic last-job invariant, pairwise unit split, capacity-Hall argument, and exact star lower bound.
integrity.reproduction: verify.py independently enumerates finite unit instances and checks online arbitrary-weight prefixes; no external data.

scientific_limitations: The online strong-EF1 result applies only when each job is eligible for at most two agents and the job has identical strictly positive processing time on its eligible agents.
The stronger EFX guarantee and the exact optimum peak-load formula require unit-size jobs; uneven sizes have no parity-orientation characterization in this result.
Fairness is the both-sided pair-restricted strong definition, not ordinary graphical EF1. The unbounded price is a lower-bound construction, not a universal upper bound.
The max-flow orientation feasibility theorem is classical and is not asserted to be independently new.
title: Pairwise eligibility makes strong envy fairness exact, but peak load can grow linearly
